title: Understanding Silhouette Scores
text: A silhouette score measures how similar an object is to its own cluster compared to other clusters. A negative silhouette score indicates that the object is closer to a neighboring cluster than to its own cluster.

title: Interpreting Negative Silhouette Scores
text: If a point has a negative silhouette score, it suggests that the point might be misclassified or that the clusters are not well-separated.

hintAnswer: It is closer to the nearest cluster than to its own cluster.
title: Analyzing Cluster Proximity
text: Consider a point with a negative silhouette score. What does this imply about its proximity to other clusters?
choices: It is closer to the nearest cluster than to its own cluster.
It is equidistant from all clusters.
It is far from all clusters.

title: Cluster Separation
text: A negative silhouette score often indicates poor cluster separation. This can happen when clusters overlap or are not distinct.
